live.note: One observation only (46.8 s end to end, including queue, download and ffprobe). Requires Azure sign-in, the gitignored .env, ffprobe on PATH, and sends the prompt to fal outside Microsoft facilities.

caveats: Generated video is labeled as MiniMax H3 Max Turbo output; it is one smoke sample, not a benchmark. No other model has generated a clip.
Fal services operate outside Microsoft facilities; Microsoft customer agreements, DPA and certifications do not apply (Microsoft Learn). Send only benign public prompts.
Fal.EnableDeploy was registered and fal terms accepted by the subscription Owner on Nov 9 ~2:50 PM PST. This demo accepted no terms.
Catalog showed all five models in eastus2 and four (no Kling) in swedencentral; none in eastus or northcentralus.
Deployment capacity 40 means 40 requests per 60 seconds (catalog rateLimits key 'request'), not tokens per minute.

Azure Retail Prices lists 'Azure Fal' meters per '1 Second' that match the launch table (Turbo 480P text-to-video 0.025 USD in eastus2). The meters are named 'Fal Test ...' and no Kling meter was listed; confirm against the invoice.
Cost shown is an estimate: requested 5 s x 0.025 = 0.125 USD; at the measured 5.184 s output it would be about 0.13 USD. FoundryModelEstimatedCost metric was empty right after the run.
The request ID of the smoke clip was not captured: the runner did not emit it at the time. It now does.
MiniMax output ran 5.184 s for a 5 s request, consistent with Learn's ~0.7 s note. The clip includes an AAC audio track.
The Nov 5 launch is on Microsoft Tech Community, not the Foundry devblog.
